Mithila is also the name of the legendary queen of Videha, who was famously called 'Mithilesh' in reverence.

Another reference to the name 'Mithilesh' can be found in the Hindu epic 'Ramayana', where Mithilesh is the name of King Janaka's queen, who gave birth to Lord Rama. This queen was also known as 'Sita', and was famously abducted by the demon king Ravana.
